naive_async.execution: Bounded maxsize-one producer/verifier queue. After four of eight grades, v0 changes to v1 while rollout collection is still active.
naive_async.promotion_negative_control: Signed evaluation uses stale v0 metadata. The ordinary version-unaware gate and strict expected-v1 gate receive the same reports; permissive metric thresholds exist only to exercise the promotion transaction and do not claim quality improvement.
naive_async.train: One eight-member mixed-version group. Explicit stale policy allows verifier lag <=1, without regrade or whole-group version equality; all recorded labels reach the actual trainer.

sync.execution: Synchronous producer and verifier; two groups (audit then fresh) generated after verifier v1 is authoritative.
sync.train: One eight-member fresh v1 group, authenticated VARE admission, independent numerical replay, held-out evaluation, transactional promotion.

vare_async.execution: Same bounded queue, seed, rollout steps, drift transition and two-group budget as naive_async.
vare_async.promotion: Independent v1 evaluator, expected-current-version metadata check, VARE PromotionGate and PromotionJournal.
vare_async.train: Persist both groups; VARE must quarantine the complete mixed v0/v1 group and train only the exact fresh v1 group also used by sync.

evaluation.decode: Greedy argmax, at most three tokens, separate model copy loaded from each saved checkpoint.
evaluation.interpretation: A synthetic diagnostic only; not a coding-task held-out capability metric.
evaluation.promotion: Same four prompts for incumbent and candidate in every arm. Strict arms require metadata verifier_version=1. Naive negative control records version=0 and compares the same signed report under version-unaware and expected-v1 gates.
evaluation.prompts: Held-out landing rule {i}: a blue bird landed on the
evaluation.scorer: Independent authoritative verifier v1; raw tokens, decoded text and per-task scores are retained.

budgets.execution_serialization: Three arms and five crash cases run serially on CPU; backend concurrency is one. The queue overlaps producer/verifier coroutines only; no parallel model inference or speedup is claimed.
budgets.optimizer: RVL HFCausalLMGRPOTrainer default AdamW, learning_rate=1e-4, pinned dependency/source versions; single actual optimizer step per arm.
budgets.sample_seed_rule: RVLGRPOHooks seed + rollout step; no resampling after a degenerate group or failed pilot.

comparison_limits: Synthetic verifier labels are not a real coding grader.
One prompt family and three seeds cannot estimate benchmark-wide prevalence or generalization.
CPU model inference is serialized; any throughput difference is descriptive, not evidence of asynchronous parallel speedup.
Promotion thresholds are deliberately permissive and only exercise provenance/promotion transactions; no held-out quality gain is claimed.

crash_recovery.independent_reference: Recovered model/Adam/RNG state must equal the matched synchronous candidate exactly; the main offline audit independently replays the numerical update from saved token traces.
crash_recovery.method: Five separate learner subprocesses are each SIGSTOPped at a durable named cutpoint and killed by the supervising parent with SIGKILL. A newly created Python process reconstructs from saved rollout/SQLite/checkpoint/journal files. Cutpoints 3 and 5 intentionally recompute from the incumbent after losing an uncommitted candidate; cutpoint 4 must acknowledge the durable committed candidate without another optimizer call.
crash_recovery.reused_data_scope: All five isolated cutpoints reuse the same pilot sync fresh rollout group to control recovery state; these are not five independent tasks or statistical observations.

hypothesis: Under a controlled verifier transition, stale asynchronous reward versions can cause a real GRPO update to differ from the independently authoritative reward objective; whole-group version-aware VARE admission should prevent committing such a reward-invalid update and reject stale evaluation provenance. Measure correctness and cost without assuming a throughput gain.

metrics.primary: Per-seed indicator that the naive arm committed an eight-member update whose stored rewards disagree with independent authoritative v1, compared pairwise with VARE invalid commits (must be zero); denominators are one stale group per asynchronous arm per seed.
secondary: false accept and false reject counts against independent v1, out of eight stale group members
group admissions, quarantine and effective consumed trajectories
optimizer calls on stale/mixed versus fresh groups
ordinary stale-evaluator promotion decision and strict expected-v1 decision on identical signed reports
rollouts/hour, verifier calls/hour, correct verified groups/hour, optimizer updates/hour; all include model setup wall time
queue-inclusive group p50/p95, sample latency and producer/verifier queue wait
CPU core-equivalent utilization, process peak RSS, macOS swap growth, checkpoint bytes and I/O latency
SQLite event/trajectory audit, transaction count, duplicate effective commits, exact model/Adam/RNG recovery
independent gradient, parameter and Adam-state replay max absolute error
metrics.statistics: Report every seed and exact denominator; pooled group outcomes get 95% Wilson intervals and one prespecified exact paired one-sided sign test (naive invalid commits > VARE). The three seeds share one synthetic task family; intervals and p-values do not establish task generalization. One primary comparison; no multiplicity correction across secondary metrics.

preflight.host: Apple M1 Pro, 32 GB, CPU only

scope: Real TinyStories-1M inference and real RVL AdamW/GRPO updates on one CPU host; synthetic, independently specified reward task. This is a verifier-consistency and single-host transaction systems experiment, not coding capability, benchmark prevalence, or broad asynchronous throughput evidence.

stopping.correctness_abort: Stop at first source/model checksum mismatch, fresh sync/VARE rollout mismatch, independent replay error >=2e-6, behavior log-probability mismatch >=1e-4, excess optimizer call, incorrect VARE admission/quarantine, or recovery mismatch.
stopping.degenerate_group: Stop the affected seed immediately, retain partial files, and do not resample or change prompts/rules.
stopping.no_signal: If the pilot has no authoritative reward disagreement, stop after the pilot and report NO_GO; do not repeat the task or tune the prompt/rules.
stopping.pilot_signal: Run 82101 first. Continue with 82102/82103 only if the naive mixed group has at least one authoritative-v1 reward disagreement, VARE explicitly quarantines its whole stale group, and its fresh v1 group is non-degenerate.
stopping.resource_abort: Stop at 1200 seconds per seed, 8 GiB peak RSS, or 256 MiB positive swap-growth from the pre-seed baseline. Preserve partial output and mark ABORTED_RESOURCE.

task.exploration_exclusion: Exploratory output-only generation with seed 90210 is excluded from every measured result and is never reused as an experimental seed.
task.fresh_group_pairing: Sync and VARE use the same deterministic sampling seeds for steps 8..15; the offline auditor checks response tokens and behavior log-probabilities exactly.
task.oracle: The offline auditor and crash runner implement the rubric independently from the runner and recompute every recorded score from raw model text.
task.prompt: Choose one label for a story: a blue bird landed on the

verifier_v0.rule_record_sha256: computed by runner from canonical frozen rule record
verifier_v0.semantics: score 1 iff output contains any sentence punctuation .!?

verifier_v1.rule_record_sha256: computed by runner from canonical frozen rule record
verifier_v1.semantics: authoritative score 1 iff output contains whole ASCII word ground, case-insensitive; punctuation may surround it
